title: Red Hat security advisory (AV26-1061)
description: As of October 19, 2026, Red Hat is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Fast Datapath for RHEL 10/8/9
	All versions

Migration Toolkit for Applications 8
	All versions

Migration Toolkit for Virtualization
	All versions

Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management for Kubernetes 2
	All versions

Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2
	All versions

Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Ansible Core 2
	All versions

Red Hat Certification Program for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9
	All versions

Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6/7/8/9/10
	All versions

Red Hat Hardened Images
	All versions

Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4
	All versions

Red Hat OpenStack Platform 13 (Queens)
	All versions

Red Hat OpenStack Platform 17.1
	All versions

Red Hat OpenStack Platform 18.0
	All versions

Red Hat Update Infrastructure 5
	All versions
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
